sloka: श्रुत्वा हिमवतो वाक्यं कोधाविष्टस्स दुन्दुभिः ।जगाम तां पुरीं तस्य किष्किन्धां वालिनस्तदा ॥४-११-२४॥।।
transliteration: śrutvā himavato vākyaṁ kodhāviṣṭassa dundubhiḥ ।jagāma tāṁ purīṁ tasya kiṣkindhāṁ vālinastadā ॥4-11-24॥।।

translations.english: 'Having heard Himavan, Dundubhi, seized with anger, went to Kishkindha, the city of Vali.
